name: facebook-ads-budget-pacing
description: Use for "am I on track with my Meta budget", "will I overspend this month", "how much should I be spending a day", "which ad sets are capped", "we underspent and I don't know why", "why won't this ad set spend", or a mid-month spend check — even when the user never says "pacing". Also use when someone needs to know whether adding budget to an ad set would do anything at all. Meta / Facebook Ads only.
